definitions.CERTIFIED: Only the named scoped claim, including calculation identities where explicitly stated; never model-wide certification.
definitions.PARTIAL: Measured/numerically referenced or incompletely validated; no inferential certificate.
definitions.NOT CERTIFIED: Unsupported inference; fail closed. A withheld output is not certified.
